name: Flame dial
description: A shell that stores fire: open it and a jet of flame comes out.

name: Impact dial
description: It soaks up a blow and gives it back all at once. The recoil hurts the hand that holds it.

name: Reject dial
description: An impact dial's ten-times-stronger cousin. Using it can break the user's arm.

name: Breath dial
description: A shell full of wind, for sails, for cooling, or for a sudden gust in a fight.

name: Jet dial
description: A rare shell that blasts air far harder than a breath dial: enough to drive a board across the clouds.

name: Lamp dial
description: It stores light. Opened in a dark room, or in an enemy's face, it blinds.

name: Flash dial
description: A lamp dial's brighter sister: one burst of light that leaves everyone near seeing spots.

name: Heat dial
description: It stores heat: warm hands in winter, or a scald where it is needed.

name: Axe dial
description: It stores a slashing wind that cuts like a blade.

name: Tone dial
description: It stores a sound: a song, a voice, a last message.

name: Milky dial
description: It makes a road of cloud out of thin air. A navigator's toy, and more than a toy.
